LESSON: COMPUTER HARDWARE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.2: Computer Hardware
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Computer Hardware, part of Tools and Production in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are computer hardware used?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Computer Hardware together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: learner acquires speaking, writing, listening, and teamwork skills when brainstorming

and presenting on the meaning of the term ‘computer hardware’

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner develops skills of interpretation and inference when categorising computer

hardware.

31

Values:
● Peace: learner displays tolerance when performing tasks using computer hardware.

• Responsibility: learner shows accountability when using available resources to search for information on categories of

computer hardware.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer Education and Mentorship: learner enhances leadership skills when discussing the categories of computer hardware

devices in a user environment.

Link to other subjects:

Integrated Science: learner enhances skills of connecting electric devices when connecting hardware devices.
